title: On the Convergence of Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) by observing whether the model selects a stereotyped answer over an 'unknown' option in ambiguous contexts, and tracking changes in model uncertainty and activated latent concepts across multi-round moral self-correction.
